What is HMPV?
Human Metapneumo-virus (HMPV) infection.​
• HMPV is a respiratory virus.
• It causes upper and lower respiratory diseases in people of all ages
• Higher risk to young children, older adults and people with weak immunity.

Treatment focuses on alleviating symptoms
• Staying hydrated
• Resting
• Drugs for pain and respiratory symptoms
• Oxygen support in severe cases
